text:
Asha (marketing): Quick sync — Harbor St pop-up next Tue. Need a concise ops checklist so we don't scramble the morning of. Key items: 6ft table, 2 laptops (one for demo, one for sign-ups), 1 monitor for slide loop, swag (100 stickers, 50 tees, 200 business cards), speaker slot confirmed for 15m, QR lead capture + webinar followup flow. Who can own each piece?
Connor (events): I can take volunteers & schedule. Confirmed speaker: Jonah, 15m lightning + Q&A. AV request: single HDMI + power strip, mic not needed for that room but bring a lapel just in case. Need name badges printed by Monday.
Luis (ops): Swag inventory checked — current stock: 78 stickers in warehouse A, 46 tees (S/M/L mixed), 190 cards. Ordered 50 more stickers from vendor X, eta Thu. Courier pickup for bulk swag on Mon 10:00am. I can handle labels if we have CSV. Also confirm whether swag is going to be shipped to venue or our staging address.
Maya (designer): I'll finalize banner art and one-pager tonight. Can we do a shorter headline than the deck? Suggest: "Predictable LLM inference at production scale" for banner. Also mockups for tabletop signage ready — will post link. Need logo-safe zone for sponsor strip.
Asha (marketing): Thanks. Routing for inbound leads: we want two flows — onsite leads go to immediate 'meetup' list (manual review) and then into the webinar nurture sequence (7-day cadence). Please tag all leads with utm=harbor_pop and source=meetup in the CSV so CRM mapping is automatic. Also we want to trigger a calendar invite email with deck + recording link within 24h.
Connor (events): Volunteers: @Ryan, @Priya, @Sam. Shift plan: 10:00-12:30 Ryan+Priya, 12:30-3:00 Priya+Sam. Will run a 15m micro-run at 9:15 on site. Need to confirm who brings the card reader (Square).
Luis (ops): For labels, use this template CSV header: "name,email,company,utm,source,interest_tag". I'll attach a small sample. For shipping, I will run the manifest command to create a pickup label: 
```
ship-cli create-manifest --items swag_bulk_001 --address "Harbor St Event Center, 123 Harbor St" --pickup-window "Mon 10:00-12:00" --contact "Connor 555-1212"
```
Drop-in: If anyone needs me on site for setup I can be there from 8:00-9:30.
Maya (designer): Link to mockups: https://figma.com/file/harbor-pop/maya-mockups — tabletop sign A is the one I've prioritized. I also uploaded a 1-slide handout for the speaker (800x600 png) and a 16:9 loop.
Asha (marketing): Great. Two small asks: 1) Can someone QA the sign-up flow QR? I want it to prefill a UTMs and a checkbox for webinar opt-in. 2) We need a one-line benchmark blurb for the banner that doesn't overclaim — something like: "2x throughput at 40% lower token cost in real traffic tests" — is that ok?
Connor (events): QA for QR — @Sam can test on his phone tonight. We should also print 10 backup QR cards for people who want physical.
Luis (ops): I validated vendor X shipment. If stickers don't arrive, we have 60 backup stickers from partner Y in staging. Also attached label-printing command for the badge printer: 
```
label-print --template "badge_v3" --csv labels.csv --printer "Zebra-4" --double-sided
```
Rex (logistics-bot): Automated reminder — courier pickup scheduled Mon 10:00. Slack notify to #logistics at 09:45 on pickup day.
Maya (designer): Quick note on assets — please keep logo color to primary dark-blue #0b3d66 on all prints so vendor color matches.
Asha (marketing): I'll draft the post-event webinar invite script. Draft CTA: "Missed us at Harbor St? Join our live webinar for a deeper dive + ask the engineers. RSVP gets recording and benchmark dataset." We'll A/B subject lines. Also capture which attendees asked about dedicated vs private deployments. Tag those as sales-qualified leads.
Connor (events): One last ops ask — where do we stash demo laptop power bricks? Prefer a small lockbox under table. I can bring a cable lock.
Luis (ops): I'll bring the lockbox. Also I'll export the sample labels.csv and put in the shared drive: //shared/marketing/harbor_labels.csv
Asha (marketing): Perfect. Who will be responsible for post-event lead triage? I'd like Maya to flag bad contacts (design requests) and Connor to mark onsite demo requests; Sales to own SLED/enterprise leads after 48h.
Connor (events): Agreed. I'll own 48h triage handoff. 
Maya (designer): I'll scan the one-pager and add a small sticker with a short code for promo: "RWDL-POP10" so we can track coupons.
Asha (marketing): Thanks team. Final checklist assigned: Volunteers/shift (Connor), Shipping/labels (Luis), Assets & signage (Maya), Lead routing & webinar flow (Asha). If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
Sam: Can confirm I'll test QR tonight and bring Square reader.
Ryan: I'll do the AM setup run-through.
Priya: I'll take the afternoon shift.
Rex (logistics-bot): Note — event insurance docs uploaded to drive: //shared/legal/harbor_insurance.pdf
